1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.EdgeGraph
2 
3 /-! Actual continuous paths on the polyhedral boundary, measured by Mathlib's total variation.
4 This supplies the shortest-path premise for straight original edges and face diagonals.
5 It makes no claim yet about nonoverlap of a star unfolding. -/
6 
7 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
8 
9 open scoped ENNReal NNReal
10 
11 /-- A continuous path whose entire image lies on the boundary of the solid. -/
12 structure SurfacePath (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (a b : Space) where
13   curve : Path a b
14   on_surface : ∀ t, curve t ∈ frontier P.body
15 
16 namespace SurfacePath
17 
18 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a b : Space}
19 
20 /-- Arc length, including infinite length, is the supremum of lengths of inscribed polygonal chains. -/
21 noncomputable def length (path : P.SurfacePath a b) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
22   eVariationOn path.curve.extend (Set.Icc 0 1)
23 
24 /-- Every continuous surface path is at least as long as the Euclidean chord joining its endpoints. -/
25 theorem chord_le_length (path : P.SurfacePath a b) : edist a b ≤ path.length := by
26   have bound := eVariationOn.edist_le path.curve.extend
27     (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc 0 1)
28   simpa only [Path.extend_zero, Path.extend_one] using bound
29 
30 /-- Shortest means no other continuous path on the surface has smaller arc length. -/
31 def IsShortest (path : P.SurfacePath a b) : Prop :=
32   ∀ other : P.SurfacePath a b, path.length ≤ other.length
33 
34 /-- A whole face contains the straight path between any two of its points. -/
35 noncomputable def inFace (F : P.Face) (ha : a ∈ F.val) (hb : b ∈ F.val) : P.SurfacePath a b where
36   curve := Path.segment a b
37   on_surface t := F.subset_frontier (F.convex.segment_subset ha hb (by
38     rw [← Path.range_segment]
39     exact ⟨t, rfl⟩))
40 
41 /-- The straight face path has exactly the length of its Euclidean chord. -/
42 theorem inFace_length (F : P.Face) (ha : a ∈ F.val) (hb : b ∈ F.val) :
43     (inFace F ha hb).length = edist a b := by
44   apply le_antisymm ?_ (inFace F ha hb).chord_le_length
45   change eVariationOn (Path.segment a b).extend (Set.Icc 0 1) ≤ edist a b
46   rw [eVariationOn.congr (Path.eqOn_extend_segment a b)]
47   have unit : eVariationOn (id : ℝ → ℝ) (Set.Icc 0 1) ≤ 1 := by
48     simpa using (monotone_id.monotoneOn (s := Set.univ)).eVariationOn_le
49       (Set.mem_univ (0 : ℝ)) (Set.mem_univ (1 : ℝ))
50   have bound := (lipschitzWith_lineMap a b (𝕜 := ℝ)).lipschitzOnWith.comp_eVariationOn_le
51     (show Set.MapsTo (id : ℝ → ℝ) (Set.Icc 0 1) Set.univ from fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _)
52   exact bound.trans (by simpa using mul_le_mul_right unit (nndist a b : ℝ≥0∞))
53 
54 /-- Straight paths within a face minimize length among all continuous surface paths. -/
55 theorem inFace_shortest (F : P.Face) (ha : a ∈ F.val) (hb : b ∈ F.val) :
56     (inFace F ha hb).IsShortest := by
57   intro other
58   rw [inFace_length]
59   exact other.chord_le_length
60 
61 end SurfacePath
62 
63 /-- Every original edge is realized by a shortest surface path with exactly that edge as its image. -/
64 theorem edge_has_shortest_surface_path (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (a b : P.Vertex)
65     (edge : P.edgeGraph.Adj a b) :
66     ∃ path : P.SurfacePath a b, path.IsShortest ∧
67       Set.range path.curve = segment ℝ (a : Space) (b : Space) := by
68   obtain ⟨_, F, G, _, common⟩ := edge
69   have aF : (a : Space) ∈ F.val :=
70     (common ▸ (left_mem_segment ℝ (a : Space) (b : Space))).1
71   have bF : (b : Space) ∈ F.val :=
72     (common ▸ (right_mem_segment ℝ (a : Space) (b : Space))).1
73   exact ⟨SurfacePath.inFace F aF bF, SurfacePath.inFace_shortest F aF bF, Path.range_segment _ _⟩
74 
75 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
